title: Outreach compliance lookup (jurisdiction x channel)
description: The machine half of references/compliance-notes.md section 4.1 / 4.2 / 7 and templates/legal_notices.md sections 1-2, read by scripts/validate_output.py --schema outreach-draft. It records WHICH question applies and which notice block a draft must carry; it never concludes that sending is lawful. When this file and those pages disagree, fix both in the same change: tests/run_tests.py asserts that notice_blocks agrees with the key index of templates/legal_notices.md. Not legal advice.

GCC.row: UAE and GCC (AE, SA, KW, QA, BH, OM)

resolution_note: Advertising label / opt-out required resolves in this order (compliance-notes.md section 7: country row AND channel). (1) A notice block exists for the key {{country_alpha2}}.{{channel_type}}, directly or through notice_block_channel_family: its status maps through notice_block_status_to_ad_label. (2) No block, channel corporate_email: the jurisdiction row's corporate_email_ad_label_required. (3) Anything else, or an unlisted country: unknown. The draft's flag must equal the resolved value; not_required / no are reserved for a human who cleared the case and are never produced here.
subject_prefix_note: subject_prefix is the literal the block itself mandates at the start of the Subject line (KR.corporate_email: "제목 맨 앞에 (광고) 표시", 정보통신망법 section 50). No other block states a subject-position marker, so none carries one.
fallback_line: - No notice block on file for {{country_name}} / {{channel_type}} — obtain wording before sending
not_required_line: - Not required for this jurisdiction and channel
